name: 35-hono-etag-304-header-filter
title: Use Headers.forEach when filtering 304 response headers
body: Iterate the response headers directly with forEach when stripping non-retained headers from a 304 response, instead of first copying the keys into an array.

bugs.why: Deleting headers while iterating the live Headers object with forEach skips entries, so some non-retained headers stay on the 304 response.
